message.content: {"note_claim": "Digital forensics link an X account (@joashamupitan) posting pro-APC content to INEC Chairman Amupitan's personal email and phone.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Social media users had accused the INEC chairperson of using an X account and also making partisan comments on the platform.", "reason": "The page reports on the controversy and Amupitan's denial of owning an X account, providing background context consistent with the note, but it does not contain the specific digital forensics evidence the note claims."}
